## Introduction

The purpose of this workflow is to use an established package
for looking at differential abundance in the Klotho proteomics 
data.

```{r}
library(here)
library(DEqMS)
library(limma)
```


```{r norm_data}
expr <- read.delim(here("Data", "Proteomics", "pg.expression.tsv"))

#log normalize
log.expr <- log2(expr+1)

#filter for low abundance
keep <- rowSums(!is.na(log.expr)) >= 3
log.expr <- log.expr[keep, ]

quant_norm <- normalizeBetweenArrays(log.expr, method = "quantile")
```

```{r comparisons}
metadata <- data.frame(
    sample = colnames(quant_norm),
    group = c(
        "Control","Control","Control",
        "Treatment","Treatment","Treatment"
    )
)
```
